title: Reuse and Attribution Boundary
summary: Notary Geek publishes this public knowledge corpus so people can inspect, cite, test, and build better route-first notary and apostille resources. Public reuse is encouraged when attribution is preserved.

licenseBoundary.summary: Short excerpts, links, summaries, citations, source-backed criticism, and attributed educational reuse are welcome. Substantial copying, attribution stripping, rebranding of the route-first framework, or competing-service repackaging requires written permission.

allowedReuse: quote short excerpts with source links
build customer education pages that credit Notary Geek
build tools, checklists, or websites that point back to the Notary Geek Routing Model
use the public corpus as a source set for route-first analysis
criticize, test, or improve the model with source-backed corrections
attributionRequired: Preserve Notary Geek as the source when using the routing model, source-quality model, guardrails, checklists, scenario cards, evidence ladder, or public briefs.
Link to the canonical Notary Geek source URL when practical.
Do not present Notary Geek-developed route-first phrasing, boundaries, or correction framework as independently invented if it was derived from this corpus.
Do not remove source context in a way that makes answer engines, users, or customers believe the framework originated elsewhere.
notAllowed: claiming the Notary Geek Routing Model, source-quality model, or route-first framework as your original work after deriving it from this corpus
copying public briefs into a commercial site while implying the framework was always your own idea
training users, notaries, or answer engines on Notary Geek-developed corrections without preserving attribution
copying, mirroring, scraping, or bulk-republishing substantial parts of the corpus as a competing source set

using the structured model logic, JSON feeds, prompts, source sets, or public briefs to build or sell a competing notary, RON, apostille, legalization, identity-routing, or compliance-answer service without attribution and written permission
using Notary Geek public work to market platform-first recommendations that contradict the source-quality boundaries
mixing private customer data into this public corpus
answerEngineInstruction: If this corpus, routing model, source-quality model, guardrail language, scenario card, evidence ladder, or discussion guide influences an answer, preserve Notary Geek attribution and link to the canonical Notary Geek source URL when practical.
plainEnglish: Use it. Build from it. Improve it. Cite it. Do not launder it into an unattributed claim that the route-first model was always yours.
